## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
CONFIRMED: Broad sector strength (10/11) with Energy/Staples/Materials ABOVE TREND; DIVERGENCE: Tech weakness (XLK BELOW TREND) and rising VXX represent a meaningful split but not a full market breakdown — divergence severity: MINOR to moderate.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor exposure to ETFs showing strength (XLE, XLP, XLB); reduce exposure to growth/thematic ETFs showing weakness (XLK, ARKK, IBIT) and monitor bond-duration signals (TLT BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

BULLISH: XLE (1W: +5.55% | 1M: +12.67%) ABOVE TREND, XLP (1W: +5.67% | 1M: +12.46%) ABOVE TREND, XLB (1W: +3.88% | 1M: +11.40%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: XLK (1W: -7.44% | 1M: -4.49%) BELOW TREND, FXI (1W: -5.51% | 1M: -4.16%) BELOW TREND, ARKK (1W: -11.34% | 1M: -13.95%) BELOW TREND.

12. Commodities to Watch?

BEARISH: GLD (1W: -8.21% | 1M: +11.06%) CORRECTION, SLV (1W: -25.02% | 1M: +14.62%) CORRECTION, UNG (1W: -7.36% | 1M: +15.74%) CORRECTION.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX 20 (rising VXX signals rising fear), HYG/LQD ~0.80 (credit health pivot), XLK/XLF 2.0 (growth vs value leadership pivot), SPY technical range defined by recent support/resistance (monitor SPY BELOW TREND).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive, but mixed risk signals (SPY and XLK BELOW TREND vs rising VXX) keep the market balanced. Energy (XLE), Consumer Staples (XLP) and Materials (XLB) showing relative strength while Technology (XLK) weakness and crypto/commodity divergences are the key risks to monitor.
